name: tests-only-umoci-preflight-verified-atomic-layer-application
instr:
umoci cannot verify every image layer before unpacking mutates the filesystem. Add image-wide preflight verification, an ordered receipt for application, reporting, and bundle publication, and named-image verification without bundle creation.

Every registered gzip, zstd, and identity algorithm must verify complete streams, count compressed and uncompressed bytes, and classify source or framing failures without decoder-specific contracts. Media-type suffixes, including empty identity, select the verifier and algorithm identity in `VerificationError` from `github.com/opencontainers/umoci/oci/casext/blobcompress`.

Preflight must verify stored descriptor digest and size before accepting decompressed bytes or tar contents, treat valid embedded and stored descriptors as equivalent identities, and match decompressed digests to configuration DiffIDs by manifest index. Reject cardinality disagreements. Report a DiffID mismatch with its index and expected DiffID.

A successful `ManifestVerification` from `github.com/opencontainers/umoci/oci/layer` must preserve order, bind each `LayerVerification` to verified staged bytes, and release staging resources when closed so later application fails cleanly. Failures must publish no rootfs, config, mtree, or metadata artifact, including after valid earlier layers.
